overall_summary: Sample size is extremely small with low views across all 5 videos. Early indicators slightly favor betrayal (बेवफाई) and relationship nostalgia, but confidence remains low, requiring controlled exploration.

winning_patterns.pattern: Direct emotional conflict tied to digital memory hooks
winning_patterns.evidence: 'Bewafai Ka Dard' (15 views) and 'पुराना नंबर' (12 views) outperformed abstract atmospheric themes.
winning_patterns.action: Focus hooks on concrete daily objects/actions associated with a person (e.g., chat notifications, saved contacts).

weak_patterns.evidence: 'मेज पर रखी चाय ठंडी हो गई' received only 5 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid passive atmospheric imagery as hooks; start immediately with high-relatability human actions.
